title: Typing a price needs See Financial Data with the line permissions
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role (made for this test) has 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data'. An Admin makes the records below before the test.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part line.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the part line to edit it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The line's description and quantity can be edited.
  • No sell price or cost box can be typed in.
